sentences.text: 4. Annexure A3 is an order dated 11.07.2024 in Crl.M.C.No.2852 of 2019 wherein the 3 rd accused in the very same crime had challenged the proceedings before this Court.
As per Annexure A3, a learned single Judge of this Court directed the petitioner to approach the trial court seeking discharge, if the charge had not been framed.

I find CRL.MC NO. 9423 OF 2024 2024:KER:84952 no reason to take a different stance here and feel it appropriate to relegate the petitioner to move an application for discharge, if he is legally entitled.
5. In this context, the learned Public Prosecutor, on verification of the e-court's website submitted that the discharge application filed by the 3rd accused has already been dismissed.

Notwithstanding the above, if the petitioner has not filed any earlier application and he is eligible under law to file an application for discharge, necessarily the same ought to be considered by the trial court, if so filed.
Accordingly, reserving the liberty of the petitioner to file an application for discharge, if entitled under law, this Crl.M.C. is dismissed.
